comments.body: I suspect the problem here is that we rely on the child processes to skip when there are too few devices. But initialization of those processes already assumes that it will be able to set up a multi-controller JAX runtime, which is not true. We probably need to skip the test early from the launcher process, but I'm not sure if there's an easy way for us to query the device count without initializing the full runtime there.

issue.body:
Without this, a multi-process test requesting 2 processes with one GPU each would crash on a system with only one GPU, because the 2nd process would attempt to initialize a non-existent 2nd GPU.

With this change, only 1 process will be initialized. Test cases can decide how to handle a device/process count of 1.

Closes jax-ml/jax#29513.
